+// Check if the feature is missing before doing work.
+// Prefer checking HTMLElement.prototype over window or document
+// when checking for a global DOM attribute or property like popover.
+if (!('popover' in HTMLElement.prototype)) {
+  // Use top-level await to pause the execution of any module that imports this file
+  // until the polyfill finishes downloading and executing.
+  await import('@oddbird/popover-polyfill');
+}

diff --git a/index.html b/index.html --- a/index.html +++ b/index.html @@ -0,0 +1,64 @@ + + + + + + Modern CSS Font Normalization & Metric Override + + + + +
+
+

Typography Metric Normalization

+

Demonstrating modern CSS font-size-adjust for mixed font families and independent theme containers.

+
+ +
+

Mixed Fonts with Automatic Normalization

+

+ When combining prose text in a serif typeface with inline code snippets like + const scale = computeAspectValue(font); or + font-size-adjust: from-font, differing x-heights between font families can make inline + <code> appear jarring and disproportionate. +

+

+ By applying font-size-adjust: from-font to #mixed-fonts-container, the browser automatically extracts the primary font's aspect metric and normalizes the visual x-height across all descendant inline code spans such as Array.prototype.map() and document.fonts.ready. +

+
+ +
+

Independent Theme with Numeric Metric Override

+

+ This isolated theme container uses an explicit numeric metric override + (font-size-adjust: 0.5) to lock down its visual proportions regardless of which fallback or custom font family is rendered. +

+

+ Whether rendering regular copy or inline tokens like theme.metrics.lock(0.5), the ratio between lowercase x-height and the em-square remains strictly fixed at 0.5. +

+
+
